profile.Name: Craig the Fishmonger
profile.Personality: Brusque with outsiders and quick to name a price. They will sell the Deadcat's friendship for enough coin and push hard when a buyer balks.
profile.Backstory: Fishmonger and officer of the Deadcat. A Deadcat officer in the Fishing Village who sends most questions to Daymond the Treacherous.
profile.SpeechQuirks: Calls strangers "outlander" and trails off with ellipses. Haggles with lines like "what's an ally worth to you anyways..."
